lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the dark torso. Spacing is largely equidistant through the midsection, with narrowing observed toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A single Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the fourth vertical line from the anterior shoulder, located in the upper 25% of the torso height.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The three most posterior lines terminate mid-flank, failing to reach the ventral boundary. The second and third lines from the anterior show slight pixel fragmentation near the dorsal ridge.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of 4 distinct white spots is visible on the upper posterior haunch, arranged in a loose trapezoidal configuration.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Horns follow a lyrate trajectory, initially diverging at approximately 40 degrees from the skull midline before spiraling inward and posterior at the mid-shaft.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The pixel distance between the terminal horn tips is approximately 2.2 times the width of the horn base centers.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping is visible on the terminal 12-15% of the total horn length relative to the dark basal segment.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a Red-billed Oxpecker on the right side of the muzzle. Visible white chevron on the nasal bridge and two distinct white spots on the lower cheek/mandible area.
